title: piper lanceolatum var. tricuspe
intro: Piper lanceolatum var. tricuspe, commonly known as Trispermum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Piperaceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Piper lanceolatum var. tricuspe include its ability to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation, as well as its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
